import re

def validate_string(input_string):
    # Check if the string is empty
    if not input_string:
        return False

    # Check if the string contains only allowed characters
    allowed_characters = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 ")
    if not set(input_string).issubset(allowed_characters):
        return False

    # Check if the string contains any special characters
    special_characters = set("!@#$%^&*()_+=-{}[]|;:'\",.<>/?`~")
    if any(char in special_characters for char in input_string):
        return False

    # Check if the string contains any consecutive duplicate characters
    if re.search(r'(.)\1+', input_string):
        return False

    return True
